name: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley, face away from the stack, and step forward so your extended working arm trails slightly behind your torso.
Stagger your stance, brace your core, and turn your palm forward with your elbow anchored slightly behind your hip.
Curl the handle smoothly upward by flexing your elbow until your forearm approaches your shoulder.
Lower the handle slowly back into full elbow extension behind your torso, then switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep your upper arm pinned slightly behind your ribs rather than swinging your elbow forward as you curl.
Stand tall and avoid twisting your shoulder forward to lift heavier weight.
